private-workdir
env SKYGO_TOKEN=
skygo auth init --data-dir $DATA --auth-file $AUTH --token-output admin.token
skygo auth principal add alice --role operator --auth-file $AUTH
skygo auth principal add bob --role operator --auth-file $AUTH
skygo auth principal add reader --role reader --auth-file $AUTH
skygo auth token issue alice --auth-file $AUTH --output alice.token --expires-in 24h
skygo auth token issue bob --auth-file $AUTH --output bob.token --expires-in 24h
skygo auth token issue reader --auth-file $AUTH --output reader.token --expires-in 24h
skygo --json state retention enable --data-dir $DATA --request-window 1h
retention-domain DOMAIN
server start
taskfile task.json success
skygo --token-file alice.token --json run -f task.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id shared --wait
job-id ALICE
skygo --token-file bob.token --json run -f task.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id shared --wait
job-id BOB
event-count 2
! skygo --token-file alice.token jobs get $BOB
stderr '^not_found: '
cp stderr foreign.err
! skygo --token-file alice.token jobs logs $BOB
cmp stderr foreign.err
skygo --token-file reader.token --json jobs retention
! stdout '"admin"'
! stdout 'private-task-value'
! skygo --token-file reader.token jobs retention --page-size 1
stderr 'permission_denied'
! skygo --token-file alice.token jobs prune --before 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z --yes
stderr 'permission_denied'
skygo --token-file admin.token --json jobs prune --before 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z --metadata-only --ack-unverified-terminal --yes
! stdout 'private-task-value'
! skygo --token-file alice.token run -f task.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id shared
stderr 'result expired'
! stderr $BOB
event-count 2
server stop
! stderr .
